description.zh:
配额维度。
配额项的属性，维度（Dimensions）+配额ID（QuotaActionCode）确定唯一的配额项。
> 部分云产品维度必填。云产品的配额是什么，以及配额是否必填可以从[ListProductQuotaDimensions](~~ListProductQuotaDimensions~~)获取，返回参数`Requisite`表示该维度是否必填。
description.en:
The quota dimensions.
A quota dimension is a property of a quota. The combination of Dimensions and QuotaActionCode uniquely identifies a quota.

> Dimensions are required for some Alibaba Cloud products. You can call the [ListProductQuotaDimensions](~~ListProductQuotaDimensions~~) operation to query the dimensions of a quota and check whether the dimensions are required. The Requisite parameter in the response indicates whether a dimension is required.

description.zh:
配额维度的Key。

> `Dimensions.N.Key`和`Dimensions.N.Value`必须同时设置。N的取值范围取决于对应云产品支持的维度个数。您可以通过[ListProductQuotaDimensions](~~ListProductQuotaDimensions~~)查询云产品支持的配额维度，返回数组长度就是N。
description.en:
The key of the quota dimension.

> Dimensions.N.Key and Dimensions.N.Value must be specified at the same time. The value of N is determined by the number of dimensions that the Alibaba Cloud product supports. You can call the [ListProductQuotaDimensions](~~ListProductQuotaDimensions~~) operation to query the supported dimensions. The value of N is the length of the returned array.

description.zh:
配额维度的Value。

> `Dimensions.N.Key`和`Dimensions.N.Value`必须同时设置。N的取值范围取决于对应云产品支持的维度个数。您可以通过[ListProductQuotaDimensions](~~ListProductQuotaDimensions~~)查询云产品支持的配额维度，返回数组长度就是N。
description.en:
The value of the quota dimension.

> Dimensions.N.Key and Dimensions.N.Value must be specified at the same time. The value of N is determined by the number of dimensions that the Alibaba Cloud product supports. You can call the [ListProductQuotaDimensions](~~ListProductQuotaDimensions~~) operation to query the supported dimensions. The value of N is the length of the returned array.

description.zh:
云产品的缩写名称。

> 关于如何获取云产品的缩写名称，请参见[ListProducts](~~440555~~)中的`ProductCode`。
description.en:
The abbreviation of the Alibaba Cloud product name.

> For more information, see the ProductCode parameter in [ListProducts](~~440555~~).

description.zh:
配额ID。

> 关于如何获取目标云产品的配额ID，请参见[ListProductQuotas](~~440554~~)中的`QuotaActionCode`。
description.en:
The quota ID.

> For more information, see the QuotaActionCode parameter in [ListProductQuotas](~~440554~~).

title.zh: 查询目标云产品的配额详情

example.unifiedCli: aliyun quotas get-product-quota --product-code ecs --quota-action-code q_security-groups --dimensions Value=cn-hangzhou Key=regionId --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun quotas GetProductQuota --region cn-hangzhou --QuotaActionCode 'q_security-groups' --Dimensions.1.Value 'cn-hangzhou' --Dimensions.1.Key regionId --ProductCode ecs
